verdict.rationale: Greptile is a SaaS platform with an MCP server and CLI, so issuing least-privilege credentials for agents is a fair question to ask of it. The pack, however, only shows that agents connect to the Greptile MCP via OAuth (greptile-docs-24). Nothing documents scoped tokens, permission levels, or per-agent least-privilege API keys, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.
